title: Reintentar health y publicación pública del candidate texto → audio
mission: From a runtime with unrestricted public HTTP access, verify the public generic text-to-audio candidate bytes and perform only the non-destructive backend GET health check. Record exact status/body/hash evidence; send no POST generation and promote no authority.
definition_of_done: Public candidate URL returns HTML containing the candidate marker and audio-lab-page-audio-v1 reference, with exact HTTP status and content hash recorded.
Non-destructive GET to audio-lab-page-audio-v1 without an id returns health metadata consistent with maxChars=1800 and the recovered service, with exact status/body evidence.
Any source-vs-served mismatch is persisted with exact URL and timestamp.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or /w authority pointer changes.
